name: smwmusic-phoenix-wright-ace-attorney-justice-for-all-reminiscences-pure-pain
title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney: Justice for All - Reminiscences ~ Pure Pain
description:
The sad theme associated with the third case of Justice for All, often dubbed "the worst case". It might not be the best, but at least we got this song as a consolation prize?
I made this a long while back to go alongside my even older port of Steel Samurai's Ballad. Not actually useful for an SMW hack, I suppose, unless you have sad cutscenes going on.
